Answer: A
Reason: The chest radiograph shows a complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a significant shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the left (contralateral side), which is the classic presentation of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away due to mass effect. Other causes of white-out like atelectasis would pull the mediastinum toward the opacity, while pneumonia typically does not cause such a profound shift.
